description: Balda于1954年推出的立体相机。快门速度double shutter with speeds from 1 sec. up to 1/200 sec.。使用35 mm (20 to 22 image pairs on one film possible)。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35 mm (20 to 22 image pairs on one film possible)
specs.快门: double shutter with speeds from 1 sec. up to 1/200 sec.
specs.取景器: telescope type finder, coupled to distance selector for parallax error correction
specs.英文简介: The Belplasca was the main part of VEB Belca-Werk's product palette for stereoscopic photography.
